sam_sales: FYI POC with HealthOrg hitting intermittent TLS handshake failures when using our TS SDK behind their corporate proxy. customer: Erin. reported 502 + ECONNRESET. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
jonathan_devex: can you paste the exact error and which SDK version they're on?
sam_sales: stacktrace from their Node app:
``nError: 502 Bad Gateway
 at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (_tls_wrap.js:123:23)
Caused by: Error: socket hang up
 at connResetException (internal/errors.js:622:14)
``nThey said ts-sdk v1.4.2, running in docker behind an outbound proxy that requires NTLM.
maria_eng: NTLM proxies + keep-alive + HTTP/2 can be painful. Are they using our builtin transport or passing a custom fetch/agent?
sam_sales: they used default - just `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'` and set REDWOOD_API_KEY + HTTPS_PROXY. no custom agent.
jonathan_devex: ask them to try forcing the SDK to use node-fetch with an explicit proxy agent. Example snippet to test:
``nimport fetch from 'node-fetch';
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTPS_PROXY);
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, fetch: (url, opts) => fetch(url, { ...opts, agent }) });
``nThat will confirm whether NTLM/proxy handshake is the issue.
erin_acme: tried similar and still saw occasional 502s but much less frequent. Can increase timeouts? our infra team wants to avoid long hangs.
maria_eng: SDK defaults might have aggressive short timeouts + limited retries. For POC set these env overrides:
``nREDWOOD_TIMEOUT_MS=12000
REDWOOD_MAX_RETRIES=5
REDWOOD_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=200
``nAlso please try disabling HTTP/2 in the underlying agent (some corporate proxies mishandle multiplexing).
sam_sales: customer also asked about pricing if we need to bump to dedicated for higher throughput during their evaluation. I said we'd figure out the POC reliability first and then create a pricing addendum.
jonathan_devex: from infra side, add logging around request headers and TLS versions. If they can share `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -proxy host:port` output that helps.
erin_acme: infra ran a quick capture, see snippet (sanitized):
``nClientHello TLS1.3, ciphers: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
ServerAlert level=fatal description=unexpected_message
``nNot sure why 'unexpected_message' appears only when proxy is in the path.
maria_eng: that suggests proxy is attempting to terminate TLS or doing some handshake translation. For POC we can recommend one of three paths: 1) route via a bastion host w/o NTLM, 2) use a TLS pass-through proxy, or 3) run the Private deployment (VPC) trial for their environment. I'll loop in solutions if they want Private.
sam_sales: customer also opened a quick security question: do you have SOC2 + SSO options for POC? they want to list for compliance team.
jonathan_devex: SOC2 Type II yes (link to SOC2 report doc), SSO via SAML/OIDC for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted we support API keys for POC; can do enterprise trial with SSO if they commit to dedicated.
erin_acme: thanks. For now they want to try the agent fix + increased retries. Can we get a short runbook to send to their infra?
maria_eng: I'll paste a minimal troubleshooting runbook you can share:
``n1) Try node agent test: use HttpsProxyAgent + node-fetch as shown.
2) Set envs: REDWOOD_TIMEOUT_MS=12000, REDWOOD_MAX_RETRIES=5, REDWOOD_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=200
3) Disable HTTP/2 in proxy agent (if using goproxy or similar).
4) Capture `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443 -proxy host:port` and share.
5) If NTLM issues persist, consider temporary bastion route or Private trial.
``nssam_sales: perfect. I'll send that now and propose a short Dedicated POC quote if reliability improves. Erin, I'll DM the SOC2 link and ask for preferred times for a quick infra pairing session. :rocket:
erin_acme: got it, pairing session Friday 10am PT works. thanks everyone!
